newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Fibre files for stock offering.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Fibre files for stock offering.

text.p: Advanced Fibre Communications Friday said it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of 2,600,000 shares of common stock.

In a statement, the company said of the 2,600,000 shares being offered, 2,400,000 shares will be offered by certain selling stockholders and 200,000 shares will be offered by the company. In addition, certain selling stockholders will grant the underwriters an option to purchase up to an aggregate of 390,000 additional shares to cover over-allotments.
